name: Corbins (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a red heart between two dark green branches in saltire, each surmounted by a black crow pecking the heart.
history: The official flag of Corbins is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with the red heart accompanied by two dark green branches placed in saltire below and each surmounted by a black crow pecking the heart, as in the arms; approved on 11 July 2005 and published in the DOGC on 26 July 2005.

features.role: two branches in saltire beneath the heart
